correctness.rationale: For n=2r+1, disjoint nonempty color supports of 2-subsets force either r supports each of size 2 or one support of size 3 and r-1 of size 2. The latter produces an entire 2-simplex with three corners; every boundary edge is unique to that triangle, so its barycentric subdivision collapses G_r-equivariantly to a three-spoke incidence tree, yielding a connected graph (via swaps of unused point). Graph incidence exact sequence gives integral free H1 and all conjugacy-class traces. Counts V=(2r+1)!/2^r, T=r(2r+1)!/(6*2^(r-1)), I=3T give beta1=1+(2r-3)(2r+1)!/(3*2^r). The source-color group acts freely on nodes and edges, giving Q plus q regular modules with q=(2r-3)(2r+1)!!/3 and quotient rank q+1. Ground-point orbits have one V node and r triangle types, giving a star quotient and contractibility. This proves all r>=2, not merely enumerated r<=4.
